observations: Photo 0 shows a large automotive gearbox/transfer case housing with the bellhousing side facing camera; no clear VIN/label visible.
Photo 1 shows the side of a gearbox with external casting marks and a round cover/plug area; no readable model plate.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox internals through the open housing and a separate large circular component/torque converter-like cover/plate; no readable part number.

claims.evidence: No photo shows a readable gearbox model/part number plate or stamping that confirms 'M272'.
Photos show no shipping documents, labels, or markings that confirm Belgium origin.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: Photos do not show test results (video/log) or seals/lock tabs that prove it was never opened; no sound/operation evidence.

claims.claim: Complete gearbox ... with a discount if your ready to buy
claims.evidence: Discount is a negotiation statement; no evidence in photos.

risks.risk: Wrong gearbox model/fitment (seller says 'M272' but photos don’t confirm the exact gearbox variant).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification label/part number (sticker or stamped code) and the vehicle compatibility (VIN/engine + gearbox code) from the same unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the wrong/uncertain fitment risk (worst case: buyer may not be able to install without additional parts).

risks.risk: Not actually 'complete' (missing solenoids, sensors, valve body parts, flexplate/torque converter components, or external harness connectors).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo of all included parts + close-ups of ports/connectors and the bellhousing mating surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/needs parts (worst case: additional sourcing cost).

risks.risk: Condition not proven (may have internal wear, damaged clutches/planetaries, or leaks).
risks.proof: Short video of operation after installation or bench test results, plus photos of fluid condition and any leak points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven (worst case: treat as needing overhaul / not guaranteed).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false (seals/fasteners may have been disturbed).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of sealant lines, factory paint marks, and bolt heads/torque marks around the casing seams.

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (cracks, bent housings, damaged mounting ears).
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of all mounting ears, casing edges, and any visible cracks; include a straight-edge check photo if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have hidden damage (worst case: parts replacement).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the gearbox ID label/stamped part number (the code that determines the exact gearbox variant).
Photo of the full set of included components (everything that makes it 'complete') laid out, including sensors/solenoids/valve body items and any converter/flexplate parts.
Video proof of testing (or a written test report) showing it engages and drives without abnormal noise.
Close-ups of casing seam/fasteners and seals to support 'never opened'.
Compatibility proof: vehicle make/model/engine + gearbox code (or VIN) the gearbox came from.
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox assembly, but the exact model/variant ('M272') and whether it is truly complete and tested cannot be confirmed from the images. Without the identifying label/part number and test proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
